plans.idea: Keep the original's two-column split: the left column holds the headline, the sub-copy and the eyebrow+button pair on one shared left edge, and the tin sits large on the right, centred vertically against the text block.
A centred poster stack: the tin as a large emblem at the top, then a big centred headline with its sub-copy, then the eyebrow and button as one compact centred row, all on a single vertical axis.

A diagonal composition: an oversized headline block anchors the top-left, the eyebrow+button pair sits directly under it on the same left edge, and a large tin fills the bottom-right quadrant to balance the weight.
